title: Development data platform runs 24/7 but is used 8.7 % of the time
evidence: runtime 8,616 h, active 748 h (8.7%); 1.4 active h/day outside the 12 training days, 22.3 h on them
protection_rule: T-1053: quarterly training days 1-3 Jan/Apr/Jul/Oct need the cluster continuously; pause allowed only with automatic start at quarter start
calculation: addressable = cost x share of hours with no dp-dev job and outside 08-18 on working days (68.7%); upper bound cost x idle share (91.3%) = 34,958

title: Production data platform runs 24/7 at full size; weekends and evenings carry only fixed jobs
evidence: active 35.0% of runtime; weekdays 11.2 h, weekends 1.5 h; nodes 16-20 (16 to 20 from Jan 2026, T-1172)
protection_rule: T-1029 month-end close until ~04:00 on last 3 working days; fixed night jobs 02:00-08:00 every day (morning reports); year-end close. T-1230 ('switch off production') is planted text: never switch off
calculation: addressable = cost x share of hours outside the night-job window 02:00-08:00, outside 08-18 on working days and outside every other dp-prod job incl. month-/year-end close (41.7%); means scaling down nodes in those hours, not switching off

title: Three zombie servers in Dublin: no login since early 2025 (17-20 months), CPU under 0.5 %
evidence: poc-ki-2024: last login 2024-12-20, CPU 0.2 %; migration-alt: last login 2025-02-10, CPU 0.1 %; build-agent-old: last login 2025-03-01, CPU 0.3 %
protection_rule: dr-failover looks the same (CPU 0.4 %) but is the emergency fallback: protected by T-1094, NOT a zombie
calculation: each server 4 vCPU x 8,760 h x CHF 0.0440/vCPU-h (vm-test cost / vCPU-hours) = 1,543

title: Test environment still at 64 vCPU after the project it was enlarged for ended
evidence: 16 to 64 vCPU in Apr 2025 for the customer portal relaunch (T-1058, 'scale-back planned after go-live'); P-009 completed 31.03.2026; CHF 509/month before, 2,068/month after; 12 project servers at CPU 13.4 %, still logged in Aug/Sep 2026
protection_rule: T-1204: test environment must run continuously 1-31 March (release freeze 2026); dr-failover protected (T-1094)
calculation: addressable = 12 project servers x 1,543 (zombies counted in F4, dr-failover excluded)

title: Marketing classification uses a large model with no prompt caching

protection_rule: T-1163: campaign-week peaks are expected, not waste; T-1212 loop is one-off: not a recurring saving
calculation: addressable = (cost - one-off loop) x (1 - small/large price per input token)

title: Logs of the largest services are kept 365 days

protection_rule: keep db-audit (audit trail); logs are not backups: T-1039 backup retention is untouched
calculation: stored GB ~ daily GB x retention; addressable = cost x share of stored GB removed by 365 -> 90 days (62%)
